entities.summary: Jean-Louis Mandengue is a retired male boxer from France. At the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia, he fought in the men's light-heavyweight division and lost to Brazil's Daniel Bispo in the second round of the tournament. Jean-Louis Mandengue was a athletes & competitors from Paris (b. 1971-09-16, Paris). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
